title: Confessio Fraternitatis
subtitle: The Confession of the Rosicrucian Fraternity, addressed to the Learned of Europe
author: Rosicrucian Manifestos
imprint: First printed at Cassel, 1615. Translated by Thomas Vaughan, 1652, revised by A. E. Waite; in A. E. Waite, The Real History of the Rosicrucians, London: George Redway, 1887
edition: Vaughan's translation (1652), revised by A. E. Waite against the Latin, 1887
translator: Thomas Vaughan, 1652; revised by A. E. Waite
note: Vaughan's English as Waite revised it against the Latin, the text Paul Case quotes, with Waite's notes. The advertisement printed before the Confessio in 1615 stands at its head. Set from the sacred-texts.com transcription, read word by word against the 1887 print; its slips are corrected.
